amendment.summary: v1.1 fill-timing and episode-segmentation amendment: (1) non-trading-day cycles now fill at the NEXT trading-session close instead of the prior Friday close, eliminating lookahead on weekend/holiday cycles; (2) episode gaps are measured in trading sessions between executable fill sessions instead of calendar days, so a weather event interrupted by a weekend/holiday forms ONE episode. Episode count on the archive is unchanged (16 total / 13 OOS); scored N rises 12 -> 13 (2025-11-09 Sunday entry now fills 2025-11-10, outside the fold4 head embargo). Benchmark recomputed on executable fills: +0.2405% per 2 sessions (was +0.1722%). Prior v1.0 results void per change_control.

pit.fill_base: first trading session ON/AFTER the cycle date (next trading close for weekend/holiday cycles)

events.definition: maximal run of PIT rows with freeze_prob>0 grouped by executable fill session; two freeze rows split into new episodes iff their fill sessions are >= 2 trading sessions apart

sample_size.rule: shrunk edge claim per blueprint T5; N>=30 structurally unreachable (ceiling 13)

signal.candidate: redefined freeze/cold-event signal, registered in writing before OOS scoring

trade.entry: fill at the first trading-session close ON/AFTER the episode firing row's cycle date (ojd_close); same-day for trading days, next trading close for weekend/holiday cycles
trade.costs_breakdown: 5 bps commission + 10 bps slippage per position change x2
trade.fill_timing: signal from the D 12Z cycle (published ~15:35Z) -> fill at the first trading close on/after D; no prior-close fill

metric.type: event-based trade-level net-of-benchmark Sharpe, pooled across folds

decision_rules.PASS: N>=8 and net-of-benchmark event Sharpe>1.0 and bootstrap CI lower bound>0
decision_rules.FAIL_PIVOT: N>=8 and (CI includes 0 or mean net<=0)

hard_gates.timestamp_armor: fail if feature references data published after decision cutoff
hard_gates.vintage_armor: fail if feature not from noaa-gfs-bdp-pds or vintage predates own timestamp
hard_gates.roll_jump_armor: halt if roll-date move >5x daily sigma without modeled weather event

change_control: any amendment requires new version + re-lock; prior results void
